capabilities.citation: S23 pp. 635-637 (RFC 3164 over UDP, facility 23, 1,024 bytes); fixture tests/fixtures/ied/sel/rtac/documented-example/syslog-user-logon.txt
capabilities.notes: Only tags the project logs, at or above the destination's threshold, are sent; User_Logged_On and User_Logged_Off are logged by default (S23 p. 633). Firmware before R150-V8, R151-V6, R152-V2 and R153-V0 (by branch) may send an incorrect time stamp (S23 Table A.1), so the event time from older firmware is not trusted (docs/phase1/A2-q5-rtac.md).

capabilities.citation: No device shell for monitoring (A2-sel-portfolio.md section 2); Syslog carries only the operator-set hostname (S23 p. 636), and no firmware ID

capabilities.notes: Silence is not a health signal: the RTAC sends only what the project logs (C4 source.silent)
